notes.title: Game Update!
notes.content:
Hi Treasure Hunters!

As always, we are grateful for your reviews. Thanks to your opinions and suggestions, we’re able to improve our game and solve problems for you!

Keep them coming!

Today, we’re excited to announce the Next Update for My Museum: Treasure Hunter. We hope these changes will enhance your adventure and make your experience even better!

Patch notes:


 Improved lighting in Egypt
 Changes to missions sequence in Egypt
 Small fixes to saving missions in Egypt
 Fixed an issue where you can encounter a blocker on the tutorial mission with trash bags
 Fixed an issue where you can encounter a blocker while clicking on the computer
 Fixed an issue where your game paused while using the exhibition menu
 Fixed the indicator on the hook (mummy room in Egypt)
 Fixed an issue where you could fall off from Egypt because the landscape disappeared


IMPORTANT!
For anyone having troubles with the game, especially if you played earlier playtest/demo or prologue versions. It is possible that the problem is related to the game save files from earlier versions. Try deleting the /Appdata/Local/MyMuseum/Saved folder. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833710/My_Museum_Treasure_Hunter/

notes.title: Day One Patch!
notes.content:
Hi Treasure Hunters!

As always - we are grateful for your reviews. Thanks to your opinions and suggestions, we’re able to improve our game and solve problems for you!

Keep them coming!

Today, we’re excited to announce the Day One Patch Update for My Museum: Treasure Hunter. We hope these changes will enhance your adventure and make your experience even better!

Patch notes:

-Motion blur - Replaced TAA with FXAA antialiasing
-Added arrows key bindings for movement
-Translated missing words
-Fixed an issue with missing resolution screens
-Fixed an issue where you can occur blocker while using city item
-Fixed an issue where games change your language automatically
-Fixed an issue where you can skip torch riddle with using savegame 
-Fixed an issue where you can skip scarab riddle with using savegame
-Fixed an issue where you can skip mirror mini-game with using savegame
-Fixed an issue where you got first museum without needed items to progress game
-Fixed an issue where you was able to change AZERTY on French flag but you can't revert it

IMPORTANT!
For anyone that have troubles with the game and you was playing earlier playtest/demo or prologue. It is possible that the problem is related to the game save files from earlier versions. Try deleting the /Appdata/Local/MyMuseum/Saved folder. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833710/My_Museum_Treasure_Hunter/

notes.title: Devlog #8 Treasure Hunter`s Journal - My Museum: Treasure hunter🤠
notes.content:
Welcome treasure hunters 🤠
In the next My Museum: Treasure Hunter🧭devlog
We want to show you, a new very useful feature as Journal📔, thanks to which no longer any challenge will be beyond your strength and the memories of your expeditions🧳 will remain for you and your successors

You can use the journal in two main ways

 Journal as diary 📔🖼️
 Diary as a guidebook 🧩🧾

See for yourself 👀...

1. Journal as diary 📔🖼️
Every traveler visiting the farthest corners of the world and exploring places no one has yet reached must have a journal🧾. His memories, experiences and discoveries are worth their weight in gold💰, they should be written down and preserved for future generations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/216252bdccb7eed5c51c979d96f9610520957a48.png

 2. A useful diary as a guidebook 🧩🧾
This is a very important element that will help players at times when they get stuck and can't cope with the puzzles to solve. It is also in response to feedback from players. Those who prefer bigger challenges⚡️ won't have as many prompts in the visible UI. More casual players🎮, on the other hand, will be able to use the hints in the guidebook at any time
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/b144bbc503d34a572922c4344f5bad7e1175e32c.png

PSSSST In below video you can find bonus➕ there are some shots from the new expedition, more information coming soon 🔜 

Here is video
[previewyoutube=qQPF6E0o454;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog #7 New Museum buildings - My Museum: Treasure hunter🤠
notes.content:
In the next  🧭My Museum: Treasure Hunter🤠devlog
we want to show you how the game is developing, but before all, how you will be able to develop the business in the game. At the beginning you start with one small museum🏛️ that you get as an inheritance from your grandfather🧑‍🦳. As the game develops, you will be able to take over more and create new exhibitions.

They differ in 
- purchase price 💰
- appearance/style 🏛️
- types of exhibitions 🖼️
- workshops/additional renovations 🛠️

See for yourself 👀...

Industrail, loft museum building🏛️

Outside - The museum is located in a post-industrial area, a large, spacious brick building.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/8e638062b8c46bf6e90213adc5878e2ae78a763e.png



Inside -  we can find a lot of inset space, with mezzanine floors, where visitors tired of the excess of art and culture will be able to enjoy the museum's café
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/24fd6c4c0a6164effe34f2b52f00d18ad48ea745.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/1588cfb34522a0f3905a2a7dcb248e4f68170e30.png


Classic museum building🏛️


Outside - From the outside, it will be a beautiful, sprawling monumental building with a bright marble facade
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/1dc080f8289b25852bdca33b8a6d4dce4f56d322.jpg



Inside - The museum will consist of a large exhibition hall, with a beautiful vaulted ceiling at the top and symmetrical balconies supported by massive columns. At the top will be a studio, overlooking the museum, with special restoration capabilities
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/3299ea2818aa51db403ad103988b7d2113a002d7.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/a898a5c048144854bd1c496c3b4ac38a2336a6a7.jpg


Here we additionally introduce you to the antique shop🕯️, it will be a place where we can purchase various antiques from the enthusiast to complete the exhibition🏺

Anitquarian 🕰️ 


Outside - The antique shop is located in an urban building with a shop window facing the street
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/90725eef4a40173890ba596f00724fc1c08fb398.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/6301383a09752bc09889af099215bae82aea2edd.jpg



Inside - it is a classic antique shop, quite small, cluttered with antiques run by an enthusiast
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/95781c2a028d0138f545f50dce641425c30acdcb.jpg

notes.title: Devlog #6 Change of name - My Museum: Treasure hunter
notes.content:
New name My Museum: Treasure Hunter
We decided to change the name, specifically to add the expansion Treasure Hunter 🤠 to the name 🔥.


Why did we decide to do it?
Because the game has evolved a lot from the creation of the Steam card until now. This was influenced by the creative process of our team, but before all the feedback from players we received after the release of the playtest version, the demo, the prologue 


In a post-playtest survey, the community found that you had the most fun with expeditions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/f95a2114b6b32c8f2801bb009b31dd17bca52f02.png

our game in addition to the original concept of restoring objects, museum building 🏛️ and creating exhibitions has gained the opportunity, to play the role of treasure hunter and obtain objects in remote and interesting corners of the world. 


Now you can explore

Egyptian Pyramid🏜️  There you will have to solve puzzles, search a mysterious tomb and obtain precious artifacts👑. This locations you might have already seen during testing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/1643b006d7dd8c15375e409800d48edbf35fae7d.png

[previewyoutube=aQEij6U7ZlE;full][/previewyoutube]


Forest 🌳 and WW2 Bunker🧱 this expedition is divided into two main tasks.... 

Forest - Forest, in which you will have to find the hidden entrance to the bunker. But before that, together with your friend Arti 🐕 you will be able to search for treasures using metal detector🦯

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/5448eda236e1eb04cd509b118a707120ed7ca1cb.png
[previewyoutube=4nWlvxQ5ewo;full][/previewyoutube] 

Bunker - The first task will be to find the entrance to the bunker itself. Then exploring its underground part🕸️, which will not be that easy at all. There, too, you can expect puzzles and surprises as you search to find more artifacts. PS there you can expect explosions   💣

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/1e344207a7f0a393ea6cd97240a1db521da869e8.png

[previewyoutube=bDLKTUlVN1U;full][/previewyoutube] 


Aztec ruins🌵🌴 this is our little surprise, you will have to wait for more information....😎🕵️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/da662972797dadc8f2e58d6b13e803bca8fcd824.png

notes.title: DevLog #5 - New tools and exhibitions 🏛️
notes.content:
In another Devlog`s My Museum you will be able to find new tools and thematic exhibitions. Make use of them in your museum 🏛️.

New tools 
Cyclinator - we have added a great element to the renovation of the museum building, it is a sanding machine that breathes new life into the wooden parquet. Which will help achieve a beautiful effect, as well as give you the fun of restoring old things. This type of feautre are especially popular and liked in simulator games. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/c5df3bd12ceecf3cb150a1563dd2e4f6507b1000.png

New exibition
Exitibiotn - one of the most important elements of any museum is the exhibition. It's up to you to decide how you set up the showcases, as well as what subject matter you want to show the exhibition. Just remember that this will affect the evaluation of your work and the satisfaction or lack thereof of your visitors

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/837cae0f2e16c93e5ff640f7b5981463cd32804f.png

Check video too :)
[previewyoutube=lbf6CskI5oQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: DevLog #4 - Treasure hunter and friendly companion 🐕
notes.content:
On your next trip in My Museum you will be able to find even more valuable treasures. Make use of them in your museum 🏛️.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/cc70be7ab52d0b6c0001df149efe873f7ee77034.png
Interestingly, this forest 🌳 hides a WW2 bunker, which will be the most important location of this map⛰️. Before you get there, you'll be able to use a metal detector🦯 and find other valuable items🏺. What's more, you will be helped by our great friend Arti 🐕, about whom more later in the devlog

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/ca582a305e62bb39a7686f283e59c7ef002a4478.png

It's a process like a treasure hunt under change:

- Step #1 -  feed Artie, when he is full he always finds something interesting
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/48515bc75a857a8ca35bec55202448df5e94a55d.png

- Step #2 -  search with a metal detector the area that Arti indicated
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/5448eda236e1eb04cd509b118a707120ed7ca1cb.png

- Step #3 -  pull the treasure to the surface
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/54909805f1c42fa50c6672d45a0dc9dddaffdec4.png

- Step #4 -  check what it is
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/9b5953c377a66052491c6b431e21b22768c30bfe.png

Don't forget to restore/clean the item when you return to the museum and put it on display


This is Arti's 🐕 over-sympathetic expedition companion, who will help you find the best places to search with a matal detector.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/b4a10a0213b6fbb81ca986c01e998e758313e2a8.png

His name is an abbreviation for Artifacts, such a play on words Arti Facts, Arti is a conqueror of myths, he only gives facts ;)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/8cfdf30feed3fc2da5a51df4ecfceb1f2434e80b.png

Here is the video - [previewyoutube=4nWlvxQ5ewo;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for participating in the Playtests👏, and for filling out the surveys. Your votes will not go in vain. Expeditions received the most votes for the most expect game expansion in February. notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/05482b6cb4fdaf11bcc00c3330e338a5cc5747ab.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/5c0af75e718a75cf5364c1871df3e8f91117d165.png
In the game, you enter the role of the owner, art enthusiast, restorer of antiques, but also a businessman.
Your first task will be to restore the museum that you inherited from your grandfather, return it to glory and compete for the admiration of critics and visitors!

- breathe new life into an old museum building
- hire staff and manage the business
- collect old and damaged artefacts
- restore antiques and make them regain their shine
- create the best exhibition
- organise auctions and earn
- become the largest art institution

notes.title: MY MUSEUM DEMO - STEAM NEXT FEST LIVE STREAM
notes.content:
My Museum is a educational FPV simulator designed for fans of renovation, management and history buffs! You can find there astounding renovation mechanics, enhanced economy and loads of historical facts!
Great fun for the whole family!

notes.title: My Museum Demo v1.0.6
notes.content:
Features:
- New  interaction indicators
- New songs

Bugfixes:
- Fixed showcase bug during final cutscene
- Fixed hammer interaction
- Fixed many other minor bugs

Improvements:
- Phone during first cutscene
- Workbench: Reset camera position when new antique is loaded
